name: velatura
description: Velatura — simplified local interface for Qwen-Image 2.1 on SD.Next (community project, not affiliated with SD.Next)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @velatura/core && npm run build -w @velatura/server && npm run build -w @velatura/cli && npm run build -w @velatura/ui
scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @velatura/server & npm run dev -w @velatura/ui
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @velatura/core && npm run build -w @velatura/core && npm run typecheck -w @velatura/server && npm run build -w @velatura/server && npm run typecheck -w @velatura/cli
